items.title: Apollo 12 and Surveyor 3
items.explanation: Astronaut Pete Conrad inspects the robotic Surveyor 3 lander inside an Ocean of Storms crater on the Moon, with the Lunar Module Intrepid visible in the distance.
items.credit: NASA / Apollo 12 / Alan Bean / Kevin Frank

items.title: NGC 206 and the Star Clouds of Andromeda
items.explanation: A massive stellar nursery packed with bright young blue stars located within our neighboring spiral galaxy, Andromeda (M31).
items.credit: NASA, ESA, and Hubble Heritage Team
